title: Inspect and reassess whiteboard evidence
statement: As an architect, I can inspect a whiteboard element's exact code and related intent, and see when it needs reassessment, so the design remains trustworthy as the implementation changes.
overview:
Whiteboard elements carry the semantic evidence and links that slide Items carry: pinned code, criterion and record links, exact technical-definition pins, and explicit inventory code selections. The element supplies its own geometry and reading context.

Changed code is a reason to reassess the design. Current documentation reports that debt; an author reads the changed code and publishes a new complete revision with the observed parent. Previous revisions remain inspectable at their original pins. A bare definition link does not acquire its code ownership, and a review deck retains independent changed-line coverage.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An element can carry exact code evidence, criterion and record links, saved documentation definitions and explicit inventory code selections; its separate reader actions open the corresponding saved content through the shared drawer or record page.

When referenced code changes, the element remains stale in the reader, references, status, health and reconcile until explicit reassessment publishes a new parented revision; historical revisions retain their original evidence.

References and documented-code coverage attribute direct evidence and eligible explicit inventory selections from the current active board revision to its stable element owner; historical revisions, unselected code and bare definition links do not add inherited coverage.
